summary: ASE Technology Holding filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its monthly and quarterly unaudited consolidated net revenue release, prepared to satisfy Taiwan regulatory disclosure requirements rather than to announce any transaction. September 2026 net revenues were NT$88,130 million (US$2,777 million), up 7.2% sequentially and 45.5% year over year; third-quarter revenues reached NT$244,161 million (US$7,642 million), up 27.8% sequentially and 44.8% year over year. No board recommendation, advisor, price, stake, or structural or regulatory terms are stated. No deal terms and no risk-arb angle apply; watch only operational trends.
